newsitem.title: USA: MedPartners Inc acquires Idaho group.
newsitem.headline: MedPartners Inc acquires Idaho group.

text.p: MedPartners Inc said on Tuesday it bought medical group Family Medical Clinic PA, with locations in Nampa and Caldwell, Idaho, for an undisclosed purchase price.

"The acquisition not only provides MedPartners an excellent resource for the Boise area, but also serves the company's long-term growth strategy for the entire Pacific Northwest region," MedPartners said in a statement.
The medical practice management company added that the transaction was accounted for as a purchase, but did not disclose terms of the transaction.
